hero.title: A meeting copilot only you can see
hero.subtitle: CloakView listens to your call, transcribes it live and suggests what to say next — in a private overlay that no one else on the call can see. Your API key, your control.
hero.platformsNote: Works alongside Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams
hero.mockupAlt: Illustration of the CloakView overlay on a video call: live transcription and a suggested reply, visible only to the user.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three steps. No account, no cloud, no middleman.

steps.title: Connect your key
steps.desc: Paste your own OpenAI API key. CloakView talks directly to OpenAI — never through our servers, because we don't have any.

steps.title: It listens
steps.desc: During the call, CloakView transcribes the conversation locally on your Mac and detects when it's your turn to speak.

steps.title: It suggests
steps.desc: A private overlay shows context-aware replies. Only you see them; the overlay never touches the call itself.

features.title: Built for privacy, not for lock-in
features.subtitle: Every design decision favors your control.

items.title: BYOK-first
items.desc: Bring your own OpenAI key. We never resell API access and we never mark it up.

items.title: Local-first
items.desc: No accounts, no telemetry, no backend. Your meeting data never leaves your Mac.

items.title: Private overlay
items.desc: Suggestions render on your screen only — invisible to Zoom, Meet, Teams and everyone else on the call.

items.title: Global shortcuts
items.desc: Summon or hide the overlay from any app with a keystroke you choose.

items.title: English & Spanish
items.desc: The app and this site are fully bilingual. Transcription and suggestions handle both languages.

costs.title: Honest costs
costs.body: CloakView is free in v1. You pay your own OpenAI API consumption — typically a few dollars a month for regular use — directly to OpenAI at their listed rates. We take nothing: no subscription, no markup, no cut.
points: OpenAI bills you at their public rates — we never touch your money
Revoke the key anytime and the app simply stops

items.a: No. Audio is processed on your Mac and sent to OpenAI only to transcribe and suggest, using your own key. We operate no servers, so there is nowhere for us to listen from.
Transcripts stay on your Mac. They are never uploaded to a CloakView server because no such server exists. You can review and delete them at any time.

items.q: Why should I hand my OpenAI key to an unknown app?
items.a: You shouldn't hand it to anyone — that's the point. Your key is stored in the macOS Keychain on your machine and is sent only to OpenAI's API. You can revoke it from the OpenAI dashboard at any moment.

items.q: What happens if I revoke the key?
items.a: CloakView stops working until you add a new one. Nothing breaks, nothing is lost, and we are never notified.
Yes. CloakView works alongside Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams on macOS 14.2+. Because it captures system audio locally, it needs no plugin and no bot joining your call.

items.q: Does the app connect to any server of yours?
items.a: We don't have servers. The only network traffic is between your Mac and OpenAI's API — something you can verify with any traffic inspector.

items.q: What if OpenAI's API goes down mid-meeting?
items.a: The overlay pauses and tells you, instead of pretending everything is fine. Transcription and suggestions resume when the API recovers.
That's your call to make, like using notes or a colleague's whisper in the room. CloakView is a tool; what you do with it is your responsibility.

pricing.description: CloakView is free in v1 with no subscription and no account. You only pay your own OpenAI API consumption — see honest monthly estimates by usage level.

hero.title: CloakView costs $0. Your OpenAI bill is between you and OpenAI.
hero.body: There is no CloakView subscription, no tier and no account. The app talks directly to OpenAI with your own API key, and OpenAI bills you for your consumption at their public rates. We never touch your money.
points: No subscription, no tiers, no free-to-paid bait
You pay OpenAI directly, at OpenAI's public rates
Revoke your key anytime and the app simply stops — no cancellation flow, because there is nothing to cancel

estimator.title: What your OpenAI bill could look like
estimator.subtitle: Three realistic usage profiles. The only variable is how many hours of meetings you bring to it.

profiles.name: Light
profiles.desc: A weekly sync and a couple of one-to-ones. Mostly short calls with light suggestion use.

profiles.name: Moderate
profiles.desc: Daily standups plus several client or team calls a week, with active reply suggestions.

profiles.name: Intensive
profiles.desc: Back-to-back meetings most days — sales, interviews, workshops — with suggestions running all day.

estimator.disclaimer: Approximate ranges based on OpenAI's current listed rates for transcription and chat models, checked November 2026. OpenAI sets its own prices and they change; always confirm at openai.com/api/pricing. These are estimates, not quotes.
estimator.footnote: What's covered: live transcription of your meeting audio plus the suggestion requests. What's not covered: nothing — there is no CloakView charge on top.
